prompt: A photograph of a person and a golden retriever sitting together on a cream linen sofa in a bright living room, seen at eye level from slightly in front. The person wears an oatmeal knit sweater and rests one hand on the dog's back; the person is framed from the shoulders down, so the face is out of the frame. The dog looks up calmly with a soft, relaxed expression, its head near the person's lap. Warm window light from the left, gentle long shadows across the cushions, a shallow depth of field with the dog in sharp focus. The sofa and the pair fill the lower two thirds of the frame; the upper third is an even, plain cream wall with nothing on it. Palette: cream, warm sand, soft golden fur and one muted sage green cushion. Natural, unposed and cosy, shot on a 50mm lens.
